attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count combines fixed wrapper overhead, per-request setup, token processing, and attention arithmetic with block rounding.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens * self.num_heads * self.head_size
pcvs.name: query_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures query and output processing proportional to actual token count.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens * attn_metadata.max_seq_len * self.num_heads * self.head_size
pcvs.name: attention_work
pcvs.rationale: Approximates query-key and attention-value arithmetic using constant-time entry metadata.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else (attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1) * ((attn_metadata.max_query_len + 31) // 32) * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32) * self.num_heads
pcvs.name: attention_tiles
pcvs.rationale: Captures block-rounded attention work and differences between prefill and decode.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else (attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1) * self.num_heads
pcvs.name: request_heads
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-request, per-head setup and scheduling overhead; warm-up calls yield zero.

attempts.hypothesis: The observed costs follow token and request counts interacting with 32-token KV block boundaries. Smaller-scale features should also avoid the numerical imbalance of the previous candidate.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: query_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures token-dependent work without large, constant head-dimension multipliers that can impair numerical fitting.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32)
pcvs.name: token_kv_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Models token processing across rounded KV blocks; measurements show a substantial cost step beyond sequence length 32.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1
pcvs.name: requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-request setup in both prefill and decode.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else (attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1) * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32)
pcvs.name: request_kv_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-request KV block overhead, including the observed decode cost increase for longer contexts.

attempts.hypothesis: Explicitly separating prefill and decode removes overlapping token/request predictors. Each regime appears approximately linear, with an additional cost when context exceeds 32 tokens; this tests whether regime mixing caused the persistent underprediction.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len > 1 else attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1
pcvs.name: decode_requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates decode setup from prefill processing so their coefficients can differ.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len > 1 else (attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1) * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len - 1) // 32)
pcvs.name: decode_extra_kv_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Models the approximately 15,000 additional instructions per decode request when context crosses 32 tokens.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len <= 1 else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: prefill_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Models the dominant prefill cost independently of decode.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len <= 1 else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len - 1) // 32)
pcvs.name: prefill_extra_kv_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Allows a separate prefill cost increase for additional KV blocks.

attempts.hypothesis: Short-context costs approximately follow tokens plus requests. A reduced three-column model tests whether sharing their baseline coefficient resolves unstable attribution while retaining separate token and request costs for additional KV blocks.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens + attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1
pcvs.name: query_and_request_units
pcvs.rationale: Combines token processing and request setup into a single predictor, reducing overlap between fitted columns.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len - 1) // 32)
pcvs.name: additional_token_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures additional token-dependent work when the KV context spans multiple blocks.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else (attn_metadata.query_start_loc.numel() - 1) * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len - 1) // 32)
pcvs.name: additional_request_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures additional per-request block overhead, particularly visible during decode.

attempts.hypothesis: Native tensor dimensions and scheduler metadata cardinality may expose kernel work missing from earlier predictors. All expressions use constant-time scalar or shape access.

pcvs.expression: query.shape[0]
pcvs.name: query_rows
pcvs.rationale: Observes the query tensor's native row count directly.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.scheduler_metadata is None else attn_metadata.scheduler_metadata.numel()
pcvs.name: scheduler_elements
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether scheduler metadata cardinality captures native task partitioning.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else query.shape[0] * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32)
pcvs.name: query_context_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures query work across rounded context blocks using tensor dimensions.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel()
pcvs.name: sequence_count
pcvs.rationale: Measures per-sequence overhead from the native kernel's sequence-length tensor.

attempts.hypothesis: Each workload state aggregates twelve layer calls. Persistent underprediction despite several plausible size models may reflect first-layer costs hidden within those aggregates; layer-conditioned predictors test that possibility.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: query_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains the principal token-dependent work predictor.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel() * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32)
pcvs.name: request_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures request overhead and block-rounded decode work.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or '.0.' not in layer.layer_name else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: first_layer_query_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether the first decoder layer incurs additional token-dependent initialization or dispatch work.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or '.0.' not in layer.layer_name else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel() * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32)
pcvs.name: first_layer_request_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Separates possible first-layer request and kernel setup costs from subsequent layers.

attempts.hypothesis: Layer identity did not explain the persistent discrepancy. Rounded query tiles and causal tile traversal may capture native loop counts more accurately than unrounded token-context products.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: query_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures processing proportional to actual query rows.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel() * ((attn_metadata.max_query_len + 15) // 16)
pcvs.name: query_tiles
pcvs.rationale: Models query work rounded to 16-row tiles.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel() * (((attn_metadata.max_query_len + 15) // 16 + 1) ** 2 // 4 if attn_metadata.causal and attn_metadata.max_query_len == attn_metadata.max_seq_len else (attn_metadata.max_query_len + 15) // 16 * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32))
pcvs.name: causal_attention_tiles
pcvs.rationale: Approximates triangular tile traversal for full causal prefill and rectangular traversal for cached queries.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel()
pcvs.name: requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates per-request setup from tiled kernel work.

attempts.hypothesis: The derived workload predictors have consistently failed. Testing the four raw workload dimensions may reveal dependence on per-request query and context lengths that aggregation and rounding concealed.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: query_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Measures total query rows processed.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.max_query_len
pcvs.name: max_query_length
pcvs.rationale: Exposes per-request query length directly, which aggregate token counts and rounded tiles obscure.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.max_seq_len
pcvs.name: max_context_length
pcvs.rationale: Exposes the unrounded context dimension used by attention loops.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel()
pcvs.name: requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates batch cardinality from per-request dimensions.

attempts.hypothesis: Observed mean costs approximately follow a shared token-plus-request cost with a smaller block-dependent increment. This constrained two-feature model tests whether fitting fewer overlapping terms improves attribution.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else (attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens + attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel()) * (4 + (attn_metadata.max_seq_len + 31) // 32)
pcvs.name: combined_query_work
pcvs.rationale: Combines token and request work with a modest increase for additional context blocks, reducing the number of independently fitted terms.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel() * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len - 1) // 32)
pcvs.name: additional_request_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Preserves the stronger context-block effect observed during decode.

attempts.hypothesis: Previous block products overcounted causal prefill work: only query rows beyond position 32 visit a second KV block. Counting those rows directly may explain the missing native kernel work.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len <= 1 else attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
pcvs.name: prefill_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures baseline prefill processing.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len <= 1 else max(0, attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens - 32 * attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel())
pcvs.name: prefill_second_block_rows
pcvs.rationale: For the observed full causal prefills, counts query rows extending beyond the first 32-token context block instead of charging every row for the maximum context.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len > 1 else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel()
pcvs.name: decode_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures baseline decode work independently of prefill.

pcvs.expression: 0 if attn_metadata is None or attn_metadata.max_query_len > 1 else attn_metadata.seq_lens.numel() * ((attn_metadata.max_seq_len - 1) // 32)
pcvs.name: decode_extra_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Counts additional context blocks traversed during decode.
